limits: All reference candidates are mostly vegetated; unseen ground/canopy change may be absorbed into registration.
Optical dates differ from DEM dates, especially July vs September 2024; no season correction or radiometric sensor harmonization.
H_N and H_W are spatially withheld candidate surfaces, not external surveyed controls.
W_SLUMP is a repeatable observation window, not the entire Batagay slump; do not compare its volume/area to a published full-slump value.
Independent-pair cycle closure detects internal inconsistency only; an equal DEM-node bias can still close.
Fewer than three accepted edges yields no redundant cycle; failures are retained and are not silently replaced by another method.
Four observations in three calendar years do not isolate a seasonal cycle.
Cycle rank is graph-theoretic redundancy, not statistical independence. A connected tree has zero testable cycles.
Per-region final RMSE alerts are descriptive (5% threshold), not a significance or accuracy test.
